## Selected projects

Shown anonymously for security.

- Project A, facial recognition (developer): a web platform that compares facial recognition models in trials and reports the results to decision-makers. React, SQL, AWS Workspace, JFrog.
- Project B, field data collection (developer, team of seven): case data entry from a computer or phone, moved off a legacy system, with a reporting dashboard. Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Power BI.
- Project C, case management (team lead): online forms where technical and non-technical users create requests and work on them together. Power Apps, Dataverse, GC Notify, Power BI.
- Project D, internal efficiency (team lead): overtime requests that managers submit for their staff and route for approval. Power Apps, Dataverse, GC Notify, Power BI.
